title: Selection Button — typography after #42
objective:
Open the Selection Button panel. Check both states (default and selected):

1. Label text size looks right at all three sizes — small noticeably smaller than medium, medium smaller than large. Nothing looks squashed or oversized.
2. Text is crisp and vertically centered inside the button.
3. Selected state: orange styling unchanged, text weight/size identical to before selection.

Context: the way font sizes are derived changed internally. If it was done right, NOTHING should look different from before. Anything that looks off = Fail.
reason: PR #42 merged without a visual check (no review surface existed).
